name: @core/kinetic
summary: Kinetic typography: slams, stacks, swaps, countdowns, glitches, marquees.
guide:
Kinetic typography: big words that move with intent. Pair with theme kinetic:impact (Bebas Neue, yellow) or any core theme.
SCENES: title-slam (words slam in + shake), word-stack (lines fly in alternately, one highlighted), highlight (sentence + marker-boxed phrase), big-number (giant counter over an outlined ghost), word-swap (prefix + rotating words), countdown (3-2-1-GO), terminal (typed line with cursor), glitch-title (RGB-split title), split-reveal (two halves slide together), marquee (rows of scrolling text).
ANIMATIONS: slam, stretch-in, flip-y, elastic-in, letter-drop, rise-blur (in) · wave, jitter (loop; wave runs per char on split text).
House rules: one idea per scene, 1–6 words per line, let the last word land before cutting (use kinetic:title-slam d ≥ 2).
